% Full-page background : wallpaper scales the image to 110% of the page
% width, centers it, and simply crops whatever overflows the page.
% A 2:3 portrait image at 1.1x page width always covers A4/Letter height.
% Tune the factor between 1.05 and 1.2 to control the crop.
\CenterWallPaper{1.1}{`r cover_path`}

% Text overlay on the FOREGROUND layer so it always sits above the image
\AddToShipoutPictureFG*{
  \AtPageCenter{
    \raisebox{8.8cm}{%
      \makebox(0,0){%
        \color{white}{\coverfont\bfseries\fontsize{110}{114}\selectfont 1~FORMULA}%
      }
    }
    \raisebox{5.8cm}{%
      \makebox(0,0){%
        \color{white}{\coverfont\bfseries\fontsize{22}{26}\selectfont ONE EQUATION. 817 DRIVERS. ONE ANSWER.}%
      }
    }
  }
  \AtPageLowerLeft{
    \raisebox{1.5cm}[0pt][0pt]{%

      \llap{%
        \color{white}{\coverfont\bfseries\fontsize{14}{16}\selectfont JEAN-MARIE ROY}%
      }
    }
  }
